securities.name: Strategy Strife Perpetual Preferred (STRF)
termsNotes: Fixed 10.00% annual cumulative dividend on $100 stated amount.
Quarterly cash distribution schedule.
Non-convertible.
Missed dividends accumulate; compounded-dividend rate can increase above the regular rate up to a maximum of 18%, subject to the security’s terms.
Limited clean-up and tax-redemption provisions; fundamental-change repurchase rights.
No ordinary discretionary par call comparable to STRC — do not apply an ordinary $100 call cap. Price may trade above $100 via required-yield compression.
Do not assume Strategy will redeem at $100 during ordinary conditions.
riskNotes: Dividends are not guaranteed and remain subject to declaration.
Call / redemption provisions can cap upside if activated under the terms.
Bitcoin appreciation does not mechanically increase the fixed preferred dividend.

securities.name: Strategy Stretch Perpetual Preferred (STRC)
termsNotes: $100 stated amount; variable cumulative dividend.
Strategy documented a 12.00% annualized dividend policy as of July 30, 2026 — dated and editable because the rate remains variable.
Semi-monthly payment cadence.
Strategy has stated an objective to support trading near $100 without guaranteeing it.
Ordinary optional redemption price is $101 plus accumulated unpaid dividends — not $100. Do not confuse market repurchases near/below $100 with contractual redemption.
Dividend remains subject to board declaration; current policy and rate can change.
riskNotes: Variable rate and buyback/support policy can change.
Trading near stated amount is an objective, not a guarantee.
Bitcoin appreciation does not automatically raise the preferred dividend.
